sloka: कुशलम् कौशिको राज्ञः पर्यपृच्छत् सुधार्मिकः ।अपि ते संनताः सर्वे सामंत रिपवो जिताः ॥१-१८-४६॥
transliteration: kuśalam kauśiko rājñaḥ paryapṛcchat sudhārmikaḥ ।api te saṁnatāḥ sarve sāmaṁta ripavo jitāḥ ॥1-18-46॥

translations.english: The foremost of ascetis, Viswamitra approached Vasishta and all other distinguised sages following the protocal and enquired about their welfare.
